        "import seaborn as sns\n",
        "\n",
        "from sklearn.cluster import AgglomerativeClustering\n",
        "from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler\n",
        "from sklearn.metrics import silhouette_score\n",
        "import scipy.cluster.hierarchy as sch\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"All Libraries Imported successfully!\")"
      ]

    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "import ipywidgets as widgets\n",
        "from IPython.display import display, clear_output\n",
        "\n",
        "def plot_clusters(n_clusters=5, linkage_method='ward'):\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "    X = customer_data[\n",
        "        ['Annual Income (k$)', 'Spending Score (1-100)']\n",
        "    ]\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "    model = AgglomerativeClustering(\n",
        "        n_clusters=n_clusters,\n",
        "        metric='euclidean',\n",
        "        linkage=linkage_method\n",
        "    )\n",
        "\n",
        "    labels = model.fit_predict(X)\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "    results = customer_data.copy()\n",
        "    results['Cluster'] = labels\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "    fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(16, 6))\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "    sns.scatterplot(\n",
        "        data=results,\n",
        "        x='Annual Income (k$)',\n",
        "        y='Spending Score (1-100)',\n",
        "        hue='Cluster',\n",
        "        palette='viridis',\n",
        "        s=90,\n",
        "        ax=axes[0]\n",
        "    )\n",
        "\n",
        "    axes[0].set_title(\n",
        "        f'Customer Segmentation: {n_clusters} Clusters',\n",
        "        fontsize=13,\n",
        "        fontweight='bold'\n",
        "    )\n",
        "\n",
        "    axes[0].legend(title='Cluster')\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "    cluster_counts = results['Cluster'].value_counts().sort_index()\n",
        "\n",
        "    sns.barplot(\n",
        "        x=cluster_counts.index,\n",
        "        y=cluster_counts.values,\n",
        "        hue=cluster_counts.index,\n",
        "        palette='viridis',\n",
        "        legend=False,\n",
        "        ax=axes[1]\n",
        "    )\n",
        "\n",
        "    axes[1].set_title('Number of Customers per Cluster')\n",
        "    axes[1].set_xlabel('Cluster')\n",
        "    axes[1].set_ylabel('Number of Customers')\n",
        "\n",
        "    plt.tight_layout()\n",
        "    plt.show()\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "    print(f\"Number of clusters: {n_clusters}\")\n",
        "    print(f\"Linkage method: {linkage_method}\")\n",
        "    print(\"\\nCustomers per cluster:\")\n",
        "    print(cluster_counts)\n",
        "\n",
        "cluster_dropdown = widgets.Dropdown(\n",
        "    options=[3, 4, 5, 6, 7],\n",
        "    value=5,\n",
        "    description='Clusters:'\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "linkage_dropdown = widgets.Dropdown(\n",
        "    options=['ward', 'complete', 'average', 'single'],\n",
        "    value='ward',\n",
        "    description='Linkage:'\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "dashboard = widgets.interactive(\n",
        "    plot_clusters,\n",
        "    n_clusters=cluster_dropdown,\n",
        "    linkage_method=linkage_dropdown\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "display(dashboard)"
      ],

      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "X = customer_data[\n",
        "    ['Annual Income (k$)', 'Spending Score (1-100)']\n",
        "]\n",
        "\n",
        "cluster_scores = []\n",
        "\n",
        "for k in range(2, 11):\n",
        "\n",
        "    model = AgglomerativeClustering(\n",
        "        n_clusters=k,\n",
        "        metric='euclidean',\n",
        "        linkage='ward'\n",
        "    )\n",
        "\n",
        "    labels = model.fit_predict(X)\n",
        "\n",
        "    score = silhouette_score(X, labels)\n",
        "\n",
        "    cluster_scores.append({\n",
        "        'Number of Clusters': k,\n",
        "        'Silhouette Score': round(score, 4)\n",
        "    })\n",
        "\n",
        "score_df = pd.DataFrame(cluster_scores)\n",
        "\n",
        "display(score_df)"
      ],

    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "X = customer_data[\n",
        "    ['Annual Income (k$)', 'Spending Score (1-100)']\n",
        "]\n",
        "\n",
        "model = AgglomerativeClustering(\n",
        "    n_clusters=5,\n",
        "    metric='euclidean',\n",
        "    linkage='ward'\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "customer_data['Cluster'] = model.fit_predict(X)\n",
        "\n",
        "cluster_summary = customer_data.groupby('Cluster').agg(\n",
        "    Customer_Count=('Cluster', 'size'),\n",
        "    Average_Annual_Income=('Annual Income (k$)', 'mean'),\n",
        "    Average_Spending_Score=('Spending Score (1-100)', 'mean')\n",
        ").round(2)\n",
        "\n",
        "display(cluster_summary)"
      ],

    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "from IPython.display import display, HTML\n",
        "\n",
        "# Select features\n",
        "features = [\n",
        "    'Annual Income (k$)',\n",
        "    'Spending Score (1-100)'\n",
        "]\n",
        "\n",
        "X = customer_data[features].copy()\n",
        "\n",
        "# Cluster configurations to compare\n",
        "cluster_options = [3, 4, 5, 6]\n",
        "\n",
        "results = {}\n",
        "comparison = []\n",
        "\n",
        "# Calculate clustering results\n",
        "for k in cluster_options:\n",
        "\n",
        "    model = AgglomerativeClustering(\n",
        "        n_clusters=k,\n",
        "        metric='euclidean',\n",
        "        linkage='ward'\n",
        "    )\n",
        "\n",
        "    labels = model.fit_predict(X)\n",
        "\n",
        "    score = silhouette_score(X, labels)\n",
        "\n",
        "    results[k] = labels\n",
        "\n",
        "    comparison.append({\n",
        "        'Number of Clusters': k,\n",
        "        'Silhouette Score': round(score, 4)\n",
        "    })\n",
        "\n",
        "comparison_df = pd.DataFrame(comparison)\n",
        "\n",
        "# Identify the highest score\n",
        "best_row = comparison_df.loc[\n",
        "    comparison_df['Silhouette Score'].idxmax()\n",
        "]\n",
        "\n",
        "best_k = int(best_row['Number of Clusters'])\n",
        "best_score = best_row['Silhouette Score']\n",
        "\n",
        "# Dashboard heading\n",
        "display(HTML(f\"\"\"\n",
        "<div style=\"\n",
        "    padding:25px;\n",
        "    background:linear-gradient(135deg,#172554,#4338ca);\n",
        "    color:white;\n",
        "    border-radius:15px;\n",
        "    font-family:Arial;\n",
        "    text-align:center;\n",
        "\">\n",
        "    <h1>Clustering Experiment Dashboard</h1>\n",
        "    <p>Comparison of Agglomerative Clustering Models</p>\n",
        "    <hr>\n",
        "    <h2>Best Configuration: {best_k} Clusters</h2>\n",
        "    <h3>Silhouette Score: {best_score:.4f}</h3>\n",
        "</div>\n",
        "\"\"\"))\n",
        "\n",
        "# Display comparison table\n",
        "print(\"CLUSTER EVALUATION RESULTS\")\n",
        "display(comparison_df)\n",
        "\n",
        "# Create a score comparison chart\n",
        "plt.figure(figsize=(9, 5))\n",
        "\n",
        "sns.barplot(\n",
        "    data=comparison_df,\n",
        "    x='Number of Clusters',\n",
        "    y='Silhouette Score',\n",
        "    hue='Number of Clusters',\n",
        "    palette='viridis',\n",
        "    legend=False\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.title(\n",
        "    'Silhouette Score Comparison',\n",
        "    fontsize=15,\n",
        "    fontweight='bold'\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.xlabel('Number of Clusters')\n",
        "plt.ylabel('Silhouette Score')\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.tight_layout()\n",
        "plt.show()\n",
        "\n",
        "# Visualize all four clustering configurations\n",
        "fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(15, 12))\n",
        "\n",
        "axes = axes.flatten()\n",
        "\n",
        "for ax, k in zip(axes, cluster_options):\n",
        "\n",
        "    plot_data = X.copy()\n",
        "    plot_data['Cluster'] = results[k]\n",
        "\n",
        "    sns.scatterplot(\n",
        "        data=plot_data,\n",
        "        x=features[0],\n",
        "        y=features[1],\n",
        "        hue='Cluster',\n",
        "        palette='viridis',\n",
        "        s=65,\n",
        "        ax=ax,\n",
        "        legend='brief'\n",
        "    )\n",
        "\n",
        "    ax.set_title(\n",
        "        f'Agglomerative Clustering: {k} Clusters',\n",
        "        fontsize=12,\n",
        "        fontweight='bold'\n",
        "    )\n",
        "\n",
        "    ax.set_xlabel('Annual Income (k$)')\n",
        "    ax.set_ylabel('Spending Score (1-100)')\n",
        "\n",
        "    ax.legend(title='Cluster')\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.suptitle(\n",
        "    'Comparison of Customer Segmentation Results',\n",
        "    fontsize=17,\n",
        "    fontweight='bold'\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.tight_layout()\n",
        "plt.show()\n",
        "\n",
        "# Final interpretation\n",
        "print(\"\\nFINAL EXPERIMENT SUMMARY\")\n",
        "print(\n",
        "    f\"Among the tested configurations, \"\n",
        "    f\"{best_k} clusters achieved the highest \"\n",
        "    f\"Silhouette Score ({best_score:.4f}).\"\n",
        ")"
      ],

        "Conclusion:\n",
        "\n",
        "In this project, Agglomerative Hierarchical Clustering was applied to the Mall Customers dataset to identify groups of customers based on their annual income and spending scores.\n",
        "\n",
        "The experiment evaluated different numbers of clusters using the Silhouette Score. Among the tested configurations, five clusters achieved the highest score, indicating the strongest clustering quality according to this metric within the tested range.\n",
        "\n",
        "The five resulting groups represented different customer profiles, including high-income customers with low spending, high-income customers with high spending, moderate-income customers with moderate spending, and two groups of lower-income customers with different spending patterns.\n",
        "\n",
        "The cluster visualizations and summary statistics demonstrated how unsupervised machine learning can reveal patterns in customer data. These findings may help businesses explore customer segmentation strategies and develop more targeted marketing approaches.\n",
        "\n",
        "Overall, this project provided practical experience with hierarchical clustering, dendrogram interpretation, cluster evaluation, and data visualization using Python."
